title: VXAce Problem with some scripts in RPG Maker VX Ace

posts.author: Psychoholic42
posts.body:
I'm having an issue with two scripts in my RPG Maker VX Ace project. I'm using Yami Battle Symphony and Victor's ATB script, among others. The problem is, in battle, when an ally's command window comes up, it hides the name of the character, like in this screenshot.
I want it so that the names are visible when choosing commands.

posts.author: Timtrack
posts.body:
Hello, I wrote a small patch (I also fixed a bug I observed when pressing escape):
Ruby:
#==============================================================================
# Victor ATB + Yami Battle Symphony patch
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Author: Timtrack
# date: 29/12/2025
# Requires: Victor ATB, Yami Symphony and their required scripts
#==============================================================================
# Description: fixes crash bug when pressing cancel on first turn
# Allows to restore the size of the actor list to the default one even with
# tp with option DEFAULT_BATTLE_STATUS_WIDTH
#==============================================================================
# Term of use: free for commercial and free games, credit is not required
#==============================================================================

module TIM
  module VATB_YBS
    #restores the width of the actors list to the vanilla one (can be useful if
    #tp is activated and VE_MOVE_STATUS_WINDOW is true)
    DEFAULT_BATTLE_STATUS_WIDTH = true
  end
end #TIM

#==============================================================================
# Game_Actor
#==============================================================================
class Game_Actor
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # alias method: prior_command -> ensures input index exists to avoid crash
  # (bug introduced because Victor's script skips the make_actions call)
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  alias tim_vatb_ybs_prior_command prior_command
  def prior_command
    @action_input_index ||= 0
    tim_vatb_ybs_prior_command
  end
end #Game_Actor

if TIM::VATB_YBS::DEFAULT_BATTLE_STATUS_WIDTH
#==============================================================================
# Window_BattleStatus
#==============================================================================
class Window_BattleStatus < Window_Selectable
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # overwrite method: window_width -> restore vanilla code
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def window_width
    Graphics.width - 128
  end
end #Window_BattleStatus

#==============================================================================
# Scene_Battle
#==============================================================================
class Scene_Battle
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # alias method: create_actor_command_window
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  alias tim_vatb_ybs_create_actor_command_window create_actor_command_window
  def create_actor_command_window
    tim_vatb_ybs_create_actor_command_window
    @actor_command_window.x = Graphics.width if VE_MOVE_STATUS_WINDOW
  end
end #Scene_Battle
end #TIM::VATB_YBS::DEFAULT_BATTLE_STATUS_WIDTH
